Two Foods, Four Lines

Four people. Four lines. One summary card.

THE DIRECTIONS

You will talk to four people. Record what you would say to each one. You can record again as many times as you want. When all four are recorded, click Submit.

The first time you press record, your computer will ask to use your microphone. Click Allow.

The summary card

As you record, the four lines fill in. Match each big idea to the fact that shows it.

BIG IDEAFACT

THE SCENE

Today is Idea Day at your school. You will tell the judges about your lunch cart. First you must finish your summary card. It needs four lines, and four people each have one. The judges want only facts, not what you think.

THE HISTORY

Your idea comes from a real food truck in Los Angeles. Two friends had a new idea in 2008. They put Korean meat in Mexican tacos. People found the truck online.
